_about: Sessellift Stern Q-4: the second Sessellift fixed-grip terminal style (owner, 2026-11-02), a bottom drive that carries the tensioning and a fixed top return, built from the owner's two vector layouts (Gate 0, local reference; drawn at 1:100 and 1:78.5). Millimetres in the lift frame: u toward the other terminal, v right looking along u, w up; origin on the bullwheel axle at the loading level 0.00. The layouts load up the left rope; ours load up the right, so the model is their deliberate mirror. Bottom drive only (owner): the drive carries the bottom head and the return the top head, and neither gains the other end's. The chairs, line towers and sheave rows are the FGQ-4's (the kit's). A narrower model moves what carries or guides the rope with the gauge (the LD5 rule; assets/stern_heads.py): values given against the rope ('in', 'out', 'foot', 'head') are distances outboard (+) or inboard (-) of it, the bullwheels' plates follow the gauge, and the hood, piers, column, boom and decks keep the quad's size.

common.loadedRope: right looking along u: v+ at the drive (bottom), v- at the return (top)

drive._note: The bottom drive as measured (Gate 1 review, 2026-11-02), the hood at its drawn tensioning position A (static, owner D4): a portal of 508 pipe (round legs on base plates, cap plates and saddles under a 508 pipe crossbeam); a 508 pipe frame per side outboard of the rope, from the hanger plates at the line end back under the crossbeam and through the hood to a 508 transverse pipe on the tapered back column (mitred corners); the rails hung under the frame pipes; the hood (flat vertical ends with recessed windowed walls, owner; one run of 8 panes each side) over the carriage's plates and the exposed bullwheel; a 305 square tie across the hanger plates carrying the head's rows and the lifting portal; the ladder (+v) up to the frame pipe; the catwalk across the line end from the ladder to the engine room's door (owner, 2026-11-03: only its landing plates and one rail are drawn). 'steel' items: stern_heads.members; values with rope: true are outboard (+) of the rope, which the layout draws at 2,057.

frame._note: the 508 pipe per side, its axis outboard of the rope, from the hanger plates back to the transverse pipe's axis on the back column

steel._: portal: the 508 pipe crossbeam, its end plates and rings; the saddle plates on the leg caps (fixed) and on the frame pipes (with the rope); the frame pipes' flanges either side of it; the legs' hand-hole covers

the rails under the frame pipes, from their end blocks at the column head to the line end, hung from the pipes on plates (Gate 2: they hung 57 below the pipe, N-D3; behind and ahead of the hood only, where they show); the column's front block; the transverse pipe's splice flanges; the tension anchor bracket and the rod (drawn from the anchor to 8,128; carried on to the hood's far end, inferred: the cylinder is not drawn)
the carriage under the hood (static; it rides with the hood): its top plate and spine over the wheel (10 clear of the rim, Gate 2), the post, the cover disc and the cap up to the hood's floor
the guide sheaves' mounts under the hood's floor: plate, straps, pin, the pendant plate down to the axle (inboard of the sheave), the rope-mouth bracket

catwalk._note: Owner addition 2026-11-03 (the drawing has only the ladder's landing plates, which it replaces, and the rail at 3,302-3,344): from the ladder across the line end to the engine room's door (hood.endPanes.door); grating (top, thick) on two cross beams (u, depth) between the frame pipes, from the recessed end wall to the drawn rail's line (to), v outboard of the rope; the railing (rails at the deck's top + top and + mid, the mid at the drawn rail's height; posts about every 'posts'; a toe plate) along the -v end from the rim's face (edge clear of the deck's edges) and along the line edge; the ladder's hoops guard the +v edge.

hood._note: The end profile (v, w), half, from the bottom edge up and over the crown, swept between two flat vertical ends at the drawn bottom edge's u (owner, 2026-11-03: the drawing's raked bells replaced, as the D6's ends); one run of 8 panes from 1,753 to -4,521.

ring._note: owner 2026-11-03: flat vertical ends as the D6's: the shell's rim (width) and the end wall recessed inside it

endPanes._note: Owner addition 2026-11-03 (not drawn): three flat panes in each end wall, the sides' pane size, from the sides' sill to a head 100 lower (the frame clear of the rim under the roof's curve), in a frame (width, depth) with the glass set back. The line end's middle pane is the engine room's door onto the catwalk (owner, 2026-11-03): its frame's sill at the deck, a kick panel (hood colour) over the lower glass and a pull handle.

ladder._note: +v only, climbing across the line to the catwalk's edge (v outboard of the rope); its width along u; two bent grab hoops at its sides, walk-through onto the deck (owner, 2026-11-03: the drawn stringer extensions and hoops replaced), their legs on the deck and the stringers' heads, the mid bar across

bullwheel._note: radii from the axle (mm), heights from the rope: the rim (bottom ring, lower lip, the wall with the rope seated in its groove), the dished cone from the hub out to the rim, the hub's stacked rings (the first the one LOD2 keeps); no spokes are drawn

shaft._: the drive's shaft from the hub up into the carriage plate (Gate 2)

bottom._note: the line towers' hold-down rows (kit), pinned on lug plates up to the tie between the hanger plates (the drawn pin is on the tie's line at u 6,426)

steel._: the tie (305 square, chamfered) across the hanger plates, the plate on it carrying the lifting portal's feet, the clamps

the hanger plates (42) at the frame pipes' ends, cut off at the tie's top plate, the tie bolted to their faces; two jaws on each plate round the tie's end, from the plate's foot under it to its front face (owner, 2026-11-03: the drawn posts, cap plates, rods and gussets above the tie removed as excess)

the transverse member hung under the tie (Gate 2, N-D2: drawn there in the side and end views; it floated ahead of the rails), to 646 inboard of each rope, on two straps per side from a plate under the tie

return._note: The fixed top return as measured (Gate 1 review, 2026-11-02): a chamfered box column 1,831 x 610 standing in the ground (no base plate drawn) and its upper section to the walkway; a flanged box boom past the axle with the wheel's pedestal on its nose; a 472 wide walkway on the axis railed on +v only; guide sheaves on pedestals at the ends of a cross member; a rope guard outboard of the arriving rope (v-), braced to the cross member; a box girder line frame out to a 304 square tube crossbeam, the support rows on its ends, a lifting portal standing on it. 'steel' items: stern_heads.members; values with rope: true are outboard (+) of the rope, which the layout draws at 2,057.

steel._: boom: web, top flange (to the nose), bottom flange; nose bar; end plate, pad and tabs on the upper section; the boss on the web
far out (LOD3) the boom, its end plate and pad as one block (Gate 2: they floated there)

far out (LOD3) the line frame, its plates and pad as one girder from the column to the crossbeam

the walkway's stringer (two channels) on the column's upper section, the grating on it cantilevered past its sloped end over the boom (Gate 2, N-R8: the tab and clamp at the wheel end aren't drawn, removed)

bullwheel._note: radii from the axle (mm), heights from the rope; the rim a bottom flange and a wall, the rope seated in the groove on its outer face; the top plate a ring (its spider arms are the spokes' flush tops)

deck._: walk: the grating's top, 2 over the stringer (drawn 3,365); the frame's 102 channels to top stand above it as toe boards (Gate 2, N-R1)

top._note: the FGQ-4 drive's 4-sheave support trains on plates at the 304 square tube crossbeam's ends (inboard of the ropes); the 6 and 8 sheave rows (the line towers' kit) as the other fixed grips' top heads, pinned on lug plates up to the crossbeam
